verdict.rationale: Google Workspace exposes REST APIs (Admin SDK, Directory, Reports, Cloud Identity) and Apps Script that let admins automate tasks programmatically, which can be invoked from scripts/CI without a UI, but there's no evidence of a general CLI, headless runtime, or first-class automation story spanning core Workspace apps (Docs/Sheets/Gmail) — and probes show no machine-readable API/llms.txt discovery. missing for 10: unified headless/CI-friendly tooling across all Workspace products, official CLI, and independent confirmation of API use in CI pipelines.
